verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own Instant Pay marketing page claims TypeScript and Python SDKs, and documented developer APIs with authentication details exist for them to wrap. The SDK claim rests on a single marketing line, with no SDK documentation, package names, repositories or usage examples. missing for 10: SDK reference docs, install and package details, coverage of which APIs the SDKs wrap, code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs exist and work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Developer APIs for cards, payments, transactions, and expense data.
